title: One vote per juror
text: Ten jurors per country each award one point.
Juries award 3, 2 and 1 points to their top three.

title: 5 to 1
text: Juries of twenty award 5 to 1 points to their top five.
Juries award 5, 3 and 1 points to their top three.

title: One vote per juror
text: Return to ten jurors, one point each.

title: Every song scored
text: Two jurors per country score every song from 1 to 5, so the total varies: 43–107 points, about 86 on average.

title: One vote per juror
text: One-year return to ten jurors, one point each.

title: 12-point system
text: 12, 10 and 8–1 points to ten songs. Televoting from 1998, semi-finals from 2004.

title: Split vote
text: Jury and televote each award a separate set of 12-point scores.
